mapper.sql: select hss.source_id, hss.schedule_id, hss.department_id, hd.department_name, hss.doctor_id, hdoc.doctor_name, hdoc.doctor_code, hdoc.title, hs.schedule_date, hs.time_slot, hs.location, hss.total_num, hss.remain_num, hss.status, hss.del_flag, hss.create_by, hss.create_time, hss.update_by, hss.update_time, hss.remark from hospital_schedule_source hss inner join hospital_schedule hs on hss.schedule_id = hs.schedule_id and hs.del_flag = '0' left join hospital_department hd on hss.department_id = hd.department_id left join hospital_doctor hdoc on hss.doctor_id = hdoc.doctor_id
